column5: Description
Etched along all its edges are the coats of arms for both King Eamond and Queen Arzhela of Evermore.
This humble gift was given by refugees fleeing Bangkorai in gratitude for retrieving belongings stolen by invading Imperials.
A parting gift from your friend, Shifty Tom.

column4: For completing Dame Frederique's mission and recovering Makela Leki's memory stone in the Tomb of the Exiles, scholar Madaima awarded you this ring.

column5: This Daedra-touched armor was the gift of a grateful bridegroom at the Damar Farmstead in Bangkorai.
The newly widowed Queen Arzhela gifted this sash in thanks for uncovering the Imperial spy plot in Evermore.

column4: The grieving Queen Arzhela awarded these greaves for your service to a city caught between invading Reachmen and Imperials.
This ceremonial blade is an exquisite marriage of form and function.

column5: You proved yourself a formidable hunter and returned Fallen Grotto to the wyrd. Hircine himself awarded you this bone-adorned shoulder armor.
It is said the edge of this blade was honed on a type of whetstone found only in the Far Shores.
Etched with the likeness of Sep, this ring was your reward for the long trek to track down Septima Tharn in Bangkorai.

column4: This axe serves as the final blessing earned from the Hall of Heroes in Bangkorai.

column5: A gift from the Red Asp, in thanks for your service to the people of Hallin's Stand.

column4: A gift from the people of Hallin's Stand for liberating Grandeya Nuwarrah and sparking the resistance against Imperial occupation.
Grandeya Nuwarrah of Hallin's Stand gave you this staff for defeating the city's Imperial occupiers.

column2: The Water Stone or Sunken Knowledge
column5: Herald Kixathi did not see to the end of the nereid Lorelia. Nonetheless, Hermaeus Mora rewarded you with this staff for abiding by the tides of fate.
For defeating Uela of the Dark Witnesses, and destroying her heart to cleanse the forest, the Glenmoril Wyrd gifted these robes.

column4: Wyress Shannia gave you these handmade shoes in thanks for avenging the spriggans turned into lurchers at Jackdaw Cove.

column5: You earned this armor by deciding the fate of Kerbol's Hollow, a hidden village of werewolves.
Knight Commander Cheryline awarded this armor as thanks for defending Martyr's Crossingv and helping make peace with the Baandari.
Squire Theo Rocque awarded this grim weapon as thanks for helping him discover who murdered Sir Etienne during the Reachman siege on Murcien's Hamlet.
Mephala's purpose in meddling with the marriage of Najan and Adeena remains in question. But you came back with answers for Najan, who awarded you this armor.
Captain Eugien Gaercroft secured an alliance with the Glenmoril Wyrd at the cost of his daughter, Isabeth. For your help, he awarded this armor.
Captain Wardush met a bitter end in pursuit of revenge for Old Tower. His sister wives awarded this helmet as thanks for seeing to his last wishes.

column4: For aiding in Covenant spywork to send Imperial forces back to Cyrodiil, Mazrahil the Scarab awarded this dagger.

column5: Like Onsi's Breath, these gauntlets were reclaimed from the Imperial Legion by Snaruga. She gave them to you in thanks for freeing her friends from enslavement in the mine.
Father Quiston and Dame Valyrie bestowed this staff in thanks for your aid in putting Prince Adrien to rest.
The gloves are lined with tufts of goat hair, softening their touch on the wearer's skin.

column4: Gahgdar might not remember asking you to retrieve a precious book, but he was grateful enough to reward you with this necklace.

column5: The spirit of Princess Urenenya awarded these delicate gloves in thanks for freeing her soul. Perhaps she and Klathzgar will be reunited at last.

column4: Caravan contractor Zaag gave you this sword in grudging gratitude for helping her with an emotional conflict outside her pay grade.

column5: A tarnished ring earned for reuniting a scholar and his guide in the spider-infested caverns of the Sunken Road in Bangkorai.

column4: The historian Maaga was so thankful to learn which Orc clan was responsible for sacking the Chauvry estate that he awarded this necklace.
A troll-smashed ring Gluineth gave you in thanks for leading her unharmed out of Troll's Toothpick.

column5: This bow was awarded for deciding the fate of the Viridian Sentinel in the wilds of Bangkorai.
